hook: Airport cargo storage up *140%* without a bigger terminal
hook_b: Airport cargo storage up *140%* without a bigger terminal
tldr: RGIA Shamshabad commissioned an upgraded Elevated Transfer Vehicle storage system at its cargo terminal.

beats.what: The new system raises storage for Unit Load Devices, the containers cargo flies in, from 33 to 80.
beats.why: Vertical storage lets the airport handle more cargo and several freighter operations at once in the same building.
beats.care: GHIAL says it helps time-sensitive and pharma cargo, a big part of Hyderabad's export story.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: GHIAL CEO Kadhir Kadhiravan said it strengthens Hyderabad as a hub for pharma and time-critical cargo.

cards.q: Did you know Hyderabad ships so much pharma by air?

qs: What share of Hyderabad's air cargo is pharma?
Will more storage bring more freighter flights?

facts.t: ULD storage went from *33 to 80* slots by adding vertical space, not floor area.

viz.verdict: More room for airlines and freight firms moving cargo through Hyderabad.

learn.t: ULD = Unit Load Device, the standard container or pallet cargo is loaded onto a plane in

watch: Whether cargo volumes at RGIA rise in the coming months.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Hyderabad airport commissions facility to raise storage capacity by 140%

fact: Hyderabad airport's cargo terminal storage capacity jumps by over *140%*
twist: It grew by stacking upward: *no extra terminal area* was needed.
